premises.text: Despite hundreds of millions of social-network users, people make only about four valuable new connections per year because networks reinforce existing ties rather than surface hidden valuable people
premises.evidence_span: four is the number of valuable, on average, valuable connections being made in a given year

premises.text: An iPhone app lets users select contacts, request permission, and make, manage, and track introductions on the go
premises.evidence_span: Somazi's iPhone app allows you to make, manage, and track valuable introductions on the go

premises.text: A web service broadcasts real-time needs and opportunities across networks to reach hidden networks of people you know
premises.evidence_span: Socializing Your Real-Time Needs is a web service that allows you to intelligently connect to the masses

value.text: Intelligently connect people to people and opportunities they do not yet know but should
value.evidence_span: connect intelligently to the people and opportunities that you don't know, but should

causal_links.evidence_span: they're not designed to actually discover hidden networks of the people that you should be connected with
strengthen your relationships on a one-on-one basis
leverage your network and connect with the networks and the hidden networks of the people you already know
